name: MYRC
oneLiner: MYRC is Blox's Malaysian ringgit stablecoin backed 1:1 by MYR at Maybank under UTMB trustee, eKYC-gated to Malaysian residents; issuer unlicensed by BNM.
collateral: Malaysian Ringgit cash deposits held in a ring-fenced bank account at Maybank (Malayan Banking Berhad) under the custody and trustee services of Universal Trustee (Malaysia) Bhd (UTMB)
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redemption against Malaysian Ringgit via Malaysian banking rails (FPX). Eligibility requires Malaysian eKYC (MyKad) and a linked Malaysian bank account; mint authority on each chain is restricted to a Blox-controlled key.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: BLOX describes MYRC as a 1:1 Malaysian Ringgit stablecoin minted and redeemed through domestic banking rails, with ring-fenced Maybank deposits under UTMB trustee custody. This supports the fiat-cash classification. The reviewed product, transparency, and whitepaper materials do not expose a dated reserve-balance report, account-level legal terms, independent assurance, or a full liability reconciliation.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: MYRC is presented by BLOX as a ringgit-backed stablecoin available on multiple chains, with no source-resolved external bridge or lockbox route. Pharos treats the current bridge-route profile as native issuance on the listed deployments.

reserves.name: MYR cash deposits at Maybank (UTMB trustee)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Malayan Banking Berhad (Maybank), with Universal Trustee (Malaysia) Bhd as trustee

reserveReview.rationale: BLOX describes MYRC as a 1:1 Malaysian Ringgit stablecoin and the existing source metadata identifies MYR cash deposits at Maybank under Universal Trustee (Malaysia) Bhd. The reviewed transparency page confirms the 1:1 reserve policy and redemption claim but does not expose a current report document or balance-period detail, so the existing single bank-deposit slice is preserved without adding unsupported subcategories.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: BLOX MYRC product and transparency disclosures for the Maybank/UTMB reserve envelope
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve class and named bank/trustee are identified. Current account balances, reserve-period detail, and account-level legal terms are not exposed on the reviewed public page.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The existing MYRC collateral description identifies a ring-fenced Maybank account under UTMB custody and trustee services. The retrieved transparency page does not provide account-level legal documents, statutory bankruptcy treatment, or rehypothecation terms, so remoteness is recorded as contractual-only and reuse remains unknown.

notices.title: Issuer not licensed
notices.message: Blox Blockchain Sdn Bhd does not hold a Bank Negara Malaysia or Securities Commission Malaysia license. SC Malaysia disclaimed jurisdiction in 2022; BNM has not yet established a payment-stablecoin framework as of 2026.

notices.title: Small float, single-jurisdiction
notices.message: Total circulating supply is approximately MYR 5.3M (~USD 1.3M) and reserves are concentrated in a single Malaysian bank (Maybank) under a single Malaysian trustee.

mintAuthority.summary: MYRC uses OZ AccessControl on EVM chains. On Ethereum, MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE are held by a 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe 0xcca0793222422e8ac1dd48db1aa691f9d360a1c2 (Safe v1.3.0 L2, no modules/guard). All role grants confirmed via RoleGranted event scan.

controls.label: Blox MYRC minter/admin Safe (Ethereum)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295023, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xcca0793...) = true. RoleGranted event scan (Blockscout getLogs, topic0=0x2f8788...) confirms MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE granted to 0xcca0793... at block 17970681; a second DEFAULT_ADMIN grant to 0xe16f1d... was later revoked (RoleRevoked confirmed). getOwners() on 0xcca0793... = [0x76b7d8..., 0xb4bc50..., 0xa35acdb...]; getThreshold() = 2. modules() returned sentinel only (no modules). masterCopy slot = 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a (Safe v1.3.0).

controls.label: MYRC Solana mint and freeze authority (issuer keypair)
controls.evidence: At Solana slot 425797741, getAccountInfo on mint myrcAs6b... returned mintAuthority and freezeAuthority Df8T8pvE..., a System-Program-owned non-executable account (issuer keypair, EOA-equivalent).

review.evidence: MYRC Ethereum uses OZ AccessControl (non-enumerable). MINTER_ROLE confirmed held by 2-of-3 Safe 0xcca0793... via hasRole at block 25295023 and corroborated by RoleGranted event log. Safe has 3 signers, threshold 2, no modules, no guard. Arbitrum/Base deploy same implementation (same bytecode); ARB deployer 0xdae4932... does NOT hold MINTER_ROLE — consistent with safe-based role management applied post-deploy on all chains. Solana mint not checked (non-EVM, low supply on Solana vs EVM). Solana mint authority resolved at slot 425797741: issuer keypair (EOA-equivalent).
